help_menu:
✦ COMMAND CENTER ✦
Explore all commands below. All commands start with /
help_admins:
🛡 ADMIN COMMANDS
▸ /pause — Pause stream ▸ /resume — Resume stream ▸ /skip — Skip current track ▸ /stop — Stop stream ▸ /seek [sec/mm:ss] — Seek to position ▸ /seekback [dur] — Seek backward ▸ /seekforward [dur] — Seek forward ▸ /loop [disable/single/queue] — Set loop mode ▸ /shuffle — Shuffle queue ▸ /channelplay — Configure channel play ▸ /reload — Reload admin cache ▸ /bots — Show bots in group ▸ /groupdata — Show group info
help_auth:
🔐 AUTH COMMANDS
Authorized users can control the stream without being admins. ▸ /auth — Add user to auth list ▸ /unauth — Remove user from auth list ▸ /authlist — Show authorized users
help_blchat:
🚫 CHAT BLACKLIST
Blacklisted chats cannot use the bot. ▸ /blacklistchat [chat_id] — Blacklist a chat ▸ /whitelistchat [chat_id] — Remove from blacklist ▸ /blacklistedchat — Show all blacklisted chats
help_bluser:
🚷 USER BLACKLIST
Blacklisted users cannot use the bot. ▸ /block [user_id] — Block a user ▸ /unblock [user_id] — Unblock a user ▸ /blockedusers — Show all blocked users
help_gban:
⚡ GLOBAL BAN
Ban users globally across all groups. ▸ /gban [user_id] [Reason] — Global ban a user ▸ /ungban [user_id] — Remove global ban ▸ /gbanlist — Show all globally banned users
help_loop:
🔁 LOOP COMMANDS
▸ /loop — Show current mode ▸ /loop disable — Disable loop ▸ /loop single — Loop current track only ▸ /loop queue — Loop entire queue
help_seek:
⏩ SEEK COMMANDS
▸ /seek [duration] — Seek to a specific time ▸ /seekback [duration] — Seek backward ▸ /seekforward [duration] — Seek forward Example: /seek 1:30 or /seek 90
help_shuffle:
🔀 SHUFFLE
▸ /shuffle — Randomly shuffle the current queue
help_maintenance:
🔧 MAINTENANCE MODE
Only Sudo users can use the bot when maintenance is enabled. ▸ /maintenance — Show current status ▸ /maintenance enable — Enable maintenance mode ▸ /maintenance disable — Disable maintenance mode
help_ping:
📡 PING & GENERAL
▸ /help — Show help menu ▸ /ping — Check ping & memory usage ▸ /start — Start the bot ▸ /sudolist — Show Sudo users
help_play:
🎵 PLAY COMMANDS
▸ /play [Song/URL/Reply] — Play audio in voice chat ▸ /vplay [Song/URL/Reply] — Play video (if enabled) ▸ /cplay [Song/URL] — Play in linked channel ▸ /cvplay [Song/URL] — Play video in linked channel ▸ /playforce — Force play (skip queue) ▸ /vplayforce — Force play video ▸ /radio — Play online radio In-Line Controls: ▸ ⏪ « 10 / « 30 — Rewind ▸ ⏩ 10 » / 30 » — Forward ▸ ⏸ ▶ — Pause / Resume ▸ ↺ — Replay current track ▸ ⏭ — Skip to next ▸ ⏹ — Stop playback Channel Play: ▸ /channelplay linked — Enable for linked channel ▸ /channelplay [channel_id] — Enable for specific channel ▸ /channelplay disable — Disable channel play
help_queue:
📋 QUEUE COMMANDS
▸ /queue — Show queued tracks ▸ /shuffle — Shuffle queue randomly ▸ /loop — Toggle loop mode
help_sudo:
👑 SUDO COMMANDS
▸ /ac — Number of active calls ▸ /activevc — List active calls ▸ /broadcast [Reply] — Broadcast to all chats • -nochat Exclude groups • -user Include users • -copy No forward tag ▸ /eval — Execute code snippet ▸ /leave — Make bot leave old chat ▸ /leaveall — Assistants leave inactive chats ▸ /logs — Send log file ▸ /logger [on/off] — Toggle logger ▸ /restart — Restart the bot ▸ /update — Update from git & restart ▸ /addsudo — Add Sudo user ▸ /rmsudo — Remove Sudo user
